about.title: About Trident Pedal Tours
about.text: Trident Pedal Tours provides scenic cultural tours and celebratory experiences aboard our customized Luxury Caztek Megacycle. Explore the vibrant streets of Nassau with our knowledgeable tour guides while enjoying the ultimate entertainment platform on wheels. Perfect for parties, celebrations, corporate events, and sightseeing.

testimonials.name: Ashley Brown
testimonials.text: This was the most unique tour experience we've ever had! The Megacycle was so much fun and our guide was incredibly knowledgeable about Nassau's history.

testimonials.name: Chris & Jessica Adams
testimonials.text: We booked the party pedal for my wife's birthday and it was absolutely epic. Music, drinks, and the best views of Nassau. Can't recommend enough!

testimonials.name: Patricia Moore
testimonials.text: Even as a local, Trident showed me parts of Nassau I'd never explored. The cultural tour is a must-do for everyone — tourists and locals alike!
